dogecoin.text: Elon Musk changed his profile photo. The $ DOGE coin icon is seen in sunglasses. There was an increase in the price of $DOGE.
#Elon Musk: I can Pump, but I don't dump. $Doge started out as a joke coin, and it would be a great irony if the Doge was the number 1 coin. #Tesla will likely continue to accept Bitcoin.
#Elon Musk: I own #Bitcoin , Tesla owns Bitcoin, SpaceX owns bitcoin. I own $ETH and $Doge.
